selected: 2026-07-14 post-holdout research selection; H0 was pre-declared before the original gate but requires new post-Jul-10 confirmation
model: mean of 5 isotonic-calibrated count models (poisson_glm, xgb_poisson, lgb_poisson, hgb_poisson, cat_poisson), NB-tail P(over)
retraining: expanding window, retrain on the 1st of each month in-season (all settled games before that date)
recalibration: fixed pre-2026 isotonic calibration; trailing-90-day Platt disabled because it reduced completed 2026 walk-forward ROI and volume

filter.edge_reference: consensus no-vig P(over) across all books at T-4h open snapshot
filter.execution: paper-track the best available price at the T-12h morning board (H0 2026 WF through Jul 10: ROI +3.60% on 629 bets / CLV +0.33pp; H0 T-4h: +2.61% on 694 / CLV +0.25pp).
filter.stake: PAPER ONLY ($0). Prior Kelly simulations are superseded because the completed forward gate failed.

conviction_layer.score: 0-100 outcome-blind reliability score: 35% model agreement, 20% sportsbook probability agreement, 20% book breadth, 10% prior-start history, 15% workload/role stability
conviction_layer.reference: component percentiles and grade cutoffs frozen from 2025 distributions without outcome labels
conviction_layer.paper_challenger: T-12h/T-6h fallback, 10-12pp edge band, grades A or B, one bet per pitcher-game
conviction_layer.warning: A/B/C was not strictly monotonic and the A/B pool was selected after review. This is a forward paper challenger, not proof of stronger live edge.

v3_1_upgrade.t4: H3 convex count-model weights selected by chronological 2025 log loss; 2026 ROI +2.89% n=717 vs H0 +2.61% n=694; log loss 0.634234 vs 0.634437
v3_1_upgrade.t12: H0 one-standard-deviation lower-confidence edge; 2025 ROI +15.12% n=693; 2026 ROI +6.31% n=401, CLV +0.48pp; Jun-Jul10 ROI -0.28% n=104, CLV +0.69pp
v3_1_upgrade.uncertainty_rule: signed conservative edge = sign(raw edge) * max(abs(raw edge) - ensemble probability SD, 0)
v3_1_upgrade.warning: Difference confidence intervals include zero. All routed stakes remain $0 until a new frozen forward window confirms the improvement.

expected.volume_per_season: ~1000-1400 bets total; ~350-450 in the conviction tier
expected.roi_estimate_base: research estimate only: H0 T-4h +2.61% on 694 bets (90% CI -4.0% to +9.0%); H0 T-12h +3.60% on 629 (CI -2.6% to +9.6%)
expected.roi_estimate_conviction: research-only A/B corroborated T-12h 10-12pp pool: 2025 +16.83% n=143; 2026 +6.78% n=106; 2026 CI still crosses zero
expected.note: No live staking until a newly protected post-Jul-10 forward period produces positive, monotone CLV and a positive ROI confidence bound.

kill_switches.clv: rolling 200-bet mean CLV < +0.3pp -> pause and retrain/review
kill_switches.roi: roi < -5% over any 300 consecutive bets -> stop
kill_switches.bias: |mean(projected mu - actual K)| > 0.25 over 100 starts -> immediate retrain
kill_switches.structure: edge->CLV quintile slope non-positive over trailing 1000 rows -> pause

provenance.2026_walk_forward: H0 +2.61% ROI n=694, CLV +0.25pp through Jul 10; positive Mar-May (+3.34%) and Jun-Jul10 (+0.60%)
provenance.selection_warning: H0 was chosen after completed 2026 results were inspected. Keep $0 stakes until a new post-Jul-10 forward window confirms it.
